panels.title: Service overview — HTTP excludes metrics/UI; business filters apply to API/SQL/nodes/features
Scrape target health
panels.description: Counts within the selected namespace/job/pod/instance scope. Missing targets require service-discovery/replica monitoring.

panels.title: Business HTTP requests/s
panels.description: Actual request paths without query strings, reaching response write completion, including failed writes. Requests rejected before the business handler are excluded.

panels.title: HTTP error ratio by status
panels.description: Each 4xx/5xx status is shown separately as a fraction of all business HTTP requests across selected instances. Statuses never observed have no series; no traffic yields N/A. SQL statement failures inside HTTP 200 are shown separately.

panels.title: HTTP P95 server latency
panels.description: From business handler execution start to response write completion. Excludes prior business queue wait and client network time. Fixed SLO buckets.

panels.title: HTTP P99 server latency
panels.description: From business handler execution start to response write completion. Excludes prior business queue wait and client network time. Fixed SLO buckets.

panels.title: HTTP average server latency
panels.description: Same timer as HTTP P95/P99; excludes queue wait before the business handler starts.

panels.title: Business executor workers
panels.description: Total official NettyEventExecutorMetrics workers across selected instances, not busy workers. Select pod/instance to drill down.

panels.title: Business executor pending tasks
panels.description: Total pending tasks and the largest individual executor queue within the selected scope. Includes pipeline tasks, not only HTTP requests.

panels.title: SQL statement outcomes/s
panels.description: REST /sql/v1 statements, including failures returned inside HTTP 200; not remote Flink job completion.

panels.title: Node execution — timers count started executions; cancellation events are separate
Node sliding-window maximum latency
panels.description: Micrometer time-window maximum; expires to zero. Not summed across pods and not an all-time maximum.

panels.title: Node P99 latency (opt-in)
panels.description: Only nodes in METRICS_HISTOGRAM_NODES publish buckets. N/A is expected for other nodes.

panels.title: Successful node output rows per execution
Node cancellation events/s
panels.description: before_start does not enter the node timer; running also appears in timer outcome=cancelled. Do not add both metrics.

panels.title: IF branch decisions/s
panels.description: Conditional IF only; TIMEIN decisions are shown below.

panels.title: TIMEIN path decisions/s
panels.description: primary_success/direct/timeout/error describe path selection. A fallback can still fail; direct is a configured policy.

panels.title: TIMEIN timeout/error fallback ratio
panels.description: Direct policy fallbacks are in the denominator but are not failures.

panels.title: Tables — no request business labels; scan may include a PK lookup
Scan output rows per successful operation
Vector search output rows per successful operation
Requested distinct converted primary keys per successful operation
Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Caffeine statistics across read-through and cache-only lookups. Only the current cache instance is bound; counters restart when it is replaced.

panels.title: Cache estimated entries
panels.description: Estimated entries across selected cache replicas, not unique keys or bytes. Expiry cleanup is asynchronous. Select pod/instance to inspect one cache.

panels.title: Cache evictions/s
panels.description: Caffeine evictions exclude explicit invalidations.

panels.title: Table write QPS
panels.description: Completed write calls per second over the rate interval, grouped by table, operation and outcome. Each batch counts as one call, not its row count. Single and batch calls are combined.

panels.title: Table write failure ratio
panels.description: Non-successful completed write calls / all completed write calls over the rate interval, grouped by table and operation. Failures include errors and timeouts; a call returning false without an exception is recorded as success. No traffic yields N/A.

panels.title: Sessions held
panels.description: Total held handles across selected instances, not currently executing SQL statements. Requires Thrift.

panels.title: Operation handles held
panels.description: Total held handles across selected instances, not currently executing SQL statements. Requires Thrift.
